name: Number Patterns
description: Nine short number sequences and sums to puzzle over.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Nine number puzzles to think about, shown on Brain Teasers.
help.goal: Nothing to win. Think it over, then reveal the answer when you are ready.
howToPlay: Read the teaser and take your time.
Press Hint for a nudge, if there is one.
Press Reveal answer to see the answer and why.
Optionally mark I got it or Not this time. This stays private.
tips: Take any teaser at your own speed. Skipping one is perfectly fine.
